basic_details.job_title: ACTREC Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Tata Memorial Centre, Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC) has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Research Scientist-I (NM) post on a project-based engagement for an initial tenure of six months, extendable based on performance and requirements. The notified pay is Rs. 72,800 p.m., and candidates must possess a post graduate degree in Life Sciences, including integrated PG degrees, while those with a 1 year PG degree are not eligible. Applicants should prepare their CV, educational documents, experience certificates, Aadhaar card soft copy, and cover letter

how_to_apply: Prepare your CV, educational documents, experience certificates, Aadhaar card (soft copy), and a cover letter.
Merge all the required documents into a single PDF format.
Send the merged PDF via email to [email protected].
Ensure the email subject clearly contains the text: “Application for the post of Project Research Scientist – I (NM), October 2026”.
Submit the application on or before 15/10/2026 till 04:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Project Research Scientist-I (NM) at a Glance

rows.details: Tata Memorial Centre, Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC)

A clinico-biological study exploring role and therapeutic manipulation of the NF-kB pathway in post-Radiotherapy progression to multiple myeloma: envisaging precision Radiotherapy for Solitary Plasmacytoma.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following qualification and age criteria to be eligible for the post: Mandatory Qualification: Post graduate degree in Life Sciences, including the integrated PG degrees (candidates with 1 year PG degree are not eligible). Desirable Qualification: Hands on experience (post MSc) in handling mammalian suspension cell lines. Age Limit: Not exceeding 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated salary is Rs. 72,800/- per month, which includes Rs. 56,000/- plus 30% HRA. The appointment duration is for six months and is extendable based on performance and project requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ACTREC Project Research Scientist-I (NM)
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV, educational documents, experience certificates, Aadhaar card (soft copy), and a cover letter. Merge all the required documents into a single PDF format. Send the merged PDF via email to [email protected] . Ensure the email subject clearly contains the text: “Application for the post of Project Research Scientist – I (NM), October 2026”. Submit the application on or before 15/10/2026 till 04:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed candidates will be contacted by e-mail and notified about the date and timings of the physical interview. There is no provision for online interviews. Applications with incomplete or non-merged documents will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the consolidated salary for the Project Research Scientist-I (NM) post?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 72,800/- per month, which comprises Rs. 56,000/- plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q2. Are candidates with a 1-year postgraduate degree eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates with a 1-year PG degree are not eligible. Applicants must hold a post graduate degree in Life Sciences, including integrated PG degrees.

faq.question: Q3. How should application documents be submitted?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their CV, educational documents, experience certificates, Aadhaar card soft copy, and a cover letter in a single merged PDF format to [email protected].

faq.question: Q4. What is the subject line required for the email application?
faq.answer: The email application must contain the subject “Application for the post of Project Research Scientist – I (NM), October 2026”.

faq.question: Q5. Will the interview be conducted online?
faq.answer: No, there will be no provision for online interviews; short-listed candidates will be notified for a physical interview.
